By brackets: 1.7274% up to €198,347, 7% on the rest.
Same method, with the other-home table: 2.2636% up to €198,347.
A flat 7.5%, with no exemption or reduction, unless an exception applies.
Having been considered a tax resident. Becoming one within two years. Letting within the legal rent caps.
